clarifications: Task scope is strictly 5 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic change is explicitly authorized by human owner for AS-005 and AS-006.
G-042 authorization is not applicable as zero guardrail code or configuration is modified.
AS-005 establishes deterministic simulation time using an explicit integer representation, independent of wall-clock time, rendering framerate/progress, browser timing, and real-time scheduling.
Conceptual progression is expressed as advanceTo(targetSimulationTime); pending scheduled events up to targetSimulationTime are processed chronologically according to canonical ordering.

Do NOT establish targetSimulationTime >= currentSimulationTime; do NOT describe simulation time as necessarily monotonic; backward-time/rewind behavior is not decided; boundary behavior at current simulation timestamp is not canonicalized.
GAP-AS-005 preserves the unresolved simulation-time integer unit/resolution without inventing concrete units.

AS-006 establishes the exact 6-tier same-timestamp canonical precedence: 1. Hard Interrupt / Control, 2. Scheduled Completion / State Transition, 3. Player Input, 4. Derived Events, 5. Skill Trigger / Activation, 6. Effect Resolution. Categories must not be reordered, collapsed, or added.

Event processing occurs through discrete event waves with pre-wave snapshot isolation for sibling trigger evaluation; sibling triggers do not observe intra-wave sibling mutations; sibling skill/effect evaluation remains isolated.

For effect-producing logic: proposed effects are represented as Effect Intents which do not directly mutate shared state during evaluation, are resolved under canonical resolution rules, and are committed atomically.

Effect Intents apply to effect-producing logic and are NOT an unapproved universal mutation mechanism for all combat transitions (such as STUN cancellation, posture transitions, or reload cancellation).
Events derived from committed results become inputs to the next wave and are not recursively processed in the same wave.
Event cascades are permitted but must be deterministically bounded; exact bound, metric, and overflow behavior remain unresolved under GAP-AS-006.
T-009 gameplay semantics (GS-001..005, GS-009) remain unchanged and authoritative; 'immediately' represents semantic ordering not delayed by rendering, animation, framerate, or wall-clock timing.
Preserve existing Gap IDs GAP-GS-001 through GAP-GS-008.
